Subject: Request for feedback on the quarterly financial report.

Dear Ms. Sharma,

I have completed the quarterly financial report and would like to know your feedback before distributing it. Specifically, can you tell me whether the data analysis is solid or not, whether the presentation style and the record are clear and professional or not, and whether the conclusions are clearly drawn from the data or not? I would be grateful if I receive any comments by Friday. Thank you for your time.

Sincerely,
Rahul
